extracted.name: Mint yogurt sauce
extracted.description: Make this simple dip inspired by Greek tzatziki and Indian raita. If you like a bit of spice, try adding toasted cumin seeds or a little cayenne pepper
ingredient_lines: 2 garlic cloves crushed or finely grated
large handful of mint leaves finely chopped
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a small bowl and season lightly with salt and generously with black pepper. Stir until completely combined, then serve straightaway, or chill for up to a day (stir before serving). Serve as a dip or condiment with barbecued meats, fish or vegetables.
